name: Fairness and Utility in AI-Generated Face Detection
description: Develop machine learning models to detect AI-generated face images while ensuring fairness across demographic groups and robustness to post-processing transformations.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: The input consists of cropped face images annotated with demographic attributes: skin tone (1-10), gender (Male: 1, Female: 0), age (0-4), and generation method (Real or AI-generated, with specific AI method labels). Example: An image with Tone 6, Male, Adult, and AI-generated using GAN.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output includes a binary classification prediction (0 for real, 1 for AI-generated), along with predicted demographic labels: skin tone (1-10), gender (0 or 1), and age category (0-4). Example: For an input image, the model might output 1 (AI-generated), Tone 6, Male, and Adult.

field.name: id
field.description: Unique identifier for the image, e.g., image_001.

field.name: pred
field.description: Prediction value for binary classification (0.0 for real, 1.0 for AI-generated).

field.name: skin_tone
field.description: Predicted skin tone on a scale of 1 to 10 (Tone1-Tone10).

field.name: gender
field.description: Predicted gender (1 for Male, 0 for Female).

field.name: age
field.description: Predicted age category (0: Child, 1: Youth, 2: Adult, 3: Middle-age Adult, 4: Senior).

cr:evaluation.notes: Metrics are computed across demographic subgroups and post-processed images to evaluate fairness, robustness, and generalization. Lower is better for EER and FPR.

open_questions: What is the exact weighting or trade-off between fairness and utility metrics in evaluation?
How should post-processing transformations be applied during inference?
Are participants required to predict the specific AI generation method, or just binary classification?
fill_in_the_blank: Exact hardware requirements beyond NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.
Specific details on how fairness metrics are aggregated for final evaluation.
